name: DashBee
description: AI-powered dashboard generator that creates dashboards from natural language prompts

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for AI-powered dashboard generation. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL (e.g., https://your-resource.openai.azure.com)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional: OpenRouter API key as an alternative to OpenAI. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional: Google Gemini API key. Get one at https://ai.google.dev/

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Secret for session encryption (generate with: openssl rand -base64 32)

ALLOWED_SCHEMAS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed database schemas

MAX_QUERY_ROWS.description: Maximum number of rows returned per query

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional: Langfuse secret key for LLM observability

LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional: Langfuse public key for LLM observability

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional: AWS access key for S3 cloud storage integration

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional: AWS secret access key for S3

GCS_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional: Google Cloud Storage project ID

GCS_KEY_FILE.description: Optional: Google Cloud Storage service account key (base64-encoded JSON)
